description: Dynaset R over T: set Filter "K > 20" and Sort "K DESC", read them back, walk ID from the current row to EOF; R.OpenRecordset() with no arguments into R2, read R2's RecordCount after MoveLast, MoveFirst and walk ID; R.Requery, MoveFirst and walk ID. Then set Filter on a table-type recordset. Asks whether Filter and Sort change the live recordset, the derived recordset, or the requeried one. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
